Metadata.Title: EA SPORTS UFC 4
Metadata.Name: Offline network: skip UPnP (DirtySDK -noupnp)
Metadata.Note: NetConnStartup (0x13256b0) creates ProtoUpnp unless its parameters carry -noupnp. ProtoUpnp opens and binds a UDP socket; the offline runtime has no sockets, so the creation failed, NetConnStartup failed whole (-6) and the game later read the destroyed DirtyCM module (fault at 0x137cde4). This takes the -noupnp branch: UPnP is never used offline.
